lines.en: I drag myself forward, slow and steady
The marsh mud grips my feet just right
Front legs brace, back legs push, not fast

lines.zh: 赌场的帘子我掀过无数次
lines.en: I have pushed that casino curtain many times

lines.zh: 我的皮在光下泛着湿亮
lines.en: My skin gleams damp in the light
I circle along the water's edge
Accounts must balance, and paths must be walked
My throat swells once
The copper in my pocket clinks
Step by step, I have patience
The swamp has plenty of time
The reeds part for me
I shuffle onto a stump for a rest
My shadow is wider than my body

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看下注的桌子
lines.en: I glance up at the betting table
I must watch this round myself

lines.zh: 我蹲在那儿，像块湿石头
lines.en: I squat there like a wet stone
My throat swells and sinks
The swamp water makes a pleasant sound
No rush to speak, first look closely
My house never opens for nothing

lines.zh: 一只虫子落在我的背上
lines.en: A bug lands on my back
I wait for customers to come themselves
My eyes sit wide apart
This hide is thick enough to soak

lines.zh: 账本在心里，不写在纸上
lines.en: The ledger lives in my head, not on paper

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，又慢慢吐出
lines.en: I take a deep breath and let it out
The marsh is quiet with only me in it
Care to place a bet, customer

lines.zh: 坐下吧，湿地上有的是位子
lines.en: Sit down, there is plenty of room in the marsh
How much is in your pocket

lines.zh: 我只收铜币、下界币或末影币
lines.en: I take copper, nether, or ender coin only
Can you afford to lose this money
I read people better than cards
Standing like that means you are hesitating
Pay up and I will bring you help
My table never cheats a regular
You smell of bees

lines.zh: 别抖手，抖手的人容易输
lines.en: Do not shake your hand, shaky hands lose
Customer, let us settle the rules first

lines.zh: 沼泽里没人陪我玩，除了你
lines.en: Nobody in this swamp plays with me but you

lines.zh: 你要是想动手，我可不掺和
lines.en: If you want a brawl, I am not joining
You bruised my hide
I step back and the mud splashes
I have written this down
It hurts, and the game is not over
I wobble and steady myself
Customer, that breaks the house rules

lines.zh: 皮被划开，我摸了摸钱袋。
lines.en: My hide is cut; I check my coin purse.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少赚了不少
lines.en: That cost me a fair bit of profit
My hide is thick, I can take more
Hit me again and I raise your price
That copper has a nice ring
A little more, and I will act
I take the money, I keep the tally
You are raising the stakes
Not enough, that is not a bet yet
I do like ender coin
Terms first, friendship later
Do not pull your hand back, customer
I smell money
All right, I take this stake

lines.zh: 泥地滑，你踩歪了我的凳子。
lines.en: The mud is slick - you knocked my stool crooked.
The marsh is slick, mind your footing
This hide of mine is not soft

lines.zh: 我退了半步，泥里起了泡
lines.en: I shift half a step and the mud bubbles

lines.zh: 靠得太近，牌就看不成了
lines.en: Any closer and we cannot see the cards
You knocked my stool crooked
Let us not tread on each other
That one does not go on the ledger
A collision in mud makes little sound

lines.zh: 你最好别把我看成软柿子
lines.en: You had better not take me for a soft target
A casino also needs a partner

lines.zh: 我这样的人，找伴不容易
lines.en: Someone like me does not find a mate easily
I know my own kind by their shape
Sitting at the same table, we could split the take
First see whether they can count

lines.zh: 沼泽的夜里，一个人太静
lines.en: The swamp nights are too quiet alone
Two frogs croaking makes it lively
Sitting side by side is enough
A companion must follow the house rules
I put up money, you put in work, deal
One scoop of my hand and the coins are in
A pity to leave this in the mud
I pinch it between my fingertips
This is the stake money
Wet things need wiping
The customer dropped it, I will hold it
I count it over once more
This little extra is a tip
I tuck it into an inner pocket
Lucky day for me
I want this one
The money is paid, so begin
It looks sturdier than it seems
I raise a hand and point
My stake goes on that one

lines.zh: 我不用自己动手，有人替我
lines.en: I need not fight, another fights for me

lines.zh: 收下这枚，接着就轮到它
lines.en: Take this coin, and it is its turn
This trade is no loss
Whatever I call up must be fierce
I am watching, do not disappoint me

lines.zh: 这几枚币，撑得住一会儿
lines.en: These coins will hold a while

lines.zh: 别让它跑回来，我付了钱
lines.en: Do not let it run back, I paid
I am deciding whether to spend the next coin
It is on the ledger, no welching
The game just started, be patient

lines.zh: 我的手在兜里摸着下一枚
lines.en: My hand feels for the next coin

lines.zh: 这一场，我看好自己这边
lines.en: I favor my side in this one
A loss is still business

lines.zh: 我脸色不变，沼泽的皮就这样
lines.en: My face does not change, a swamp hide does not
It fights passably well

lines.zh: 我抬手一挥，它就冲上去
lines.en: A wave of my hand and it charges in
That blow was bought with my coin

lines.zh: 我不亲自动手，规矩如此
lines.en: I do not fight myself, house rules
I hop in and butt once
Money in, force out

lines.zh: 我这一身皮也能顶一顶
lines.en: Even this hide can take a hit
Do not think the house cannot fight
That slap found flesh
I step back and return to the ledger
It landed loud, the money was well spent

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的泥里爬出来
lines.en: I crawl up out of the swamp mud
This place will do for a table
The marsh made me and feeds me
I count my pocket first
Nobody called me, I came on my own
Dew still hangs on the reeds
I settle down and spread my hands
Customers always come on their own

lines.zh: 我的叫声在沼泽里回响
lines.en: My croak echoes over the marsh
Rules first, then business

lines.zh: 火烤到我的湿皮，我直跳
lines.en: Fire hits my wet hide and I hop

lines.zh: 摔下来压坏了我几枚币
lines.en: The fall crushed a few of my coins
Water fills my throat and I kick
The blast tips over my stool

lines.zh: 一枚小东西扎进我的皮
lines.en: Something small sticks in my hide

lines.zh: 这法术把我的账搅乱了
lines.en: That spell scrambles my accounts
Hungry, even my counting slows
Lightning hits me and I go numb

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，也没有牌桌
lines.en: The void has no mud and no table
